answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window, so identities that answer in lockstep lose their deposits together rather than being punished one at a time, and synchronised farming becomes the single worst strategy available. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. A farm holds one ember style of behaviour, one atlas signature, and eats one basalt penalty; the ember is per identity, but the atlas and the basalt are what make the group collectively liable.
